question.text: Let $\vec{a}=2 \hat{i}-\hat{j}+\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b}=\lambda \hat{j}+2 \hat{k}, \lambda \in \boldsymbol{Z}$ be two vectors. Let $\vec{c}=\vec{a} \times \vec{b}$ and $\vec{d}$ be a vector of magnitude 2 in $y z$-plane. If $|\overrightarrow{\mathrm{c}}|=\sqrt{53}$, then the maximum possible value of $(\overrightarrow{\mathrm{c}} \cdot \overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}})^{2}$ is equal to :
